headline: US stocks fall again on AI worries; Nvidia down 8%
pages: US stocks fell for a second day on Wednesday as worries about the scale and sustainability of AI spending hit big technology companies. All three main indexes were lower, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq lost more than 2%. Nvidia shares dropped 8% in early trading, extending Tuesday's slide as the lift from Jensen Huang's return as CEO faded. Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Microsoft and Meta also fell. Nvidia's turbulent fortnight has rippled outward because it both supplies and finances many AI firms. The sell-off came as the government announced new tariffs on a long list of trading partners.
Big tech valuations have helped shield the US economy from shocks, but share prices have been volatile in recent weeks. Source: BBC News.
